1.consolidated_definition: Mueble que a modo de una estantería cobija varios equipos de entretenimiento: televisor, tocadiscos, radio, etc. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Amplia casa de 4h-1b, toda la casa con losa italiana blanca, cocina grande con muchos gabinetes y area de comedor, family equipado con entertaining center en madera wall to wall (Dubina Clasificados, consultado 19-05-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Furniture piece resembling a bookshelf that accommodates multiple entertainment systems: television, record player, radio, etc.

Note: This term is an unadapted Anglicism and relatively uncommon.

Large house of 4 bedrooms-1 bathroom, with white Italian tile flooring throughout the entire house, a large kitchen featuring many cabinets and a dining area, family room equipped with an entertainment center made of wood from floor to ceiling.
